title: Preflight de separacao entre mecanica, transporte e estabilidade

physical_trial.recovery: Create a named temporary preset before moving; after explicit Stop, return once through that preset. Keep the preset if visual return cannot be verified.

former_blocking_reason: The configured Toposync acquisition path did not produce a fresh decoder frame before the ONVIF-profile rebind.
recovery_basis: PTZ readback remains auxiliary because this camera reports move_status UNKNOWN. A temporary preset and a distributed visual correspondence check provide the recoverable return gate.
outcome: The original five-frame attempt returned outside the gate and preserved its preset. A distinct 12-second-horizon trial then established a five-frame quiet baseline, accepted one bounded pulse, and returned to the baseline with 0.0806 analysis-pixel displacement; its temporary preset was removed.
next_gate: E7 may begin with one observable but bounded pulse, using the validated quiet-window recovery protocol. A successful return does not itself characterize actuator response.
return_verification: Distributed visual correspondence from the pre-move frame to the post-return frame with overlap at least 0.85 and 95th-percentile displacement at most 15 analysis pixels.
